$comment: It is the ONLY source of document ids that tool will ever archive or
delete. An id absent from this file cannot be touched by any flag,
status is 'awaiting_ids' until the ids below are transcribed literally
from a production reconciliation report. While it holds that value the
tool refuses to run in any phase, including dry-run. Nothing here was
guessed, derived or reconstructed: the ids must be copied from the
report's present_but_removed_from_pack rows by the operator who ran it.
notes: The live reconciliation of 2026-08-28 reported: expected_and_present 0,
source pack do not overlap at all — none of the 73 ledger-cleared records
has ever been imported, and all 16 live documents predate the pack.
All 16 were reported verification=unset and contentKind=unset, and all 16
were audioMode=file with audioUrl=present. The audio files themselves are
deliberately out of scope: this path never contacts Cloud Storage, so the
objects those URLs point at survive the retirement untouched.
